integrity.exactness: Two complete finite verifiers, explicit edge construction and all optimum masks.
integrity.scope: All 2^20 dodecahedral vertex subsets checked in a standalone implementation; separate cardinality enumerator checks all potential optima.

limitations: Finite graph GP(10,2), radius one and single detector erasure only.
Failure of detectors is not the same as incorrect detector readings.
Priority of exact finite census remains subject to complete earlier-literature comparisons.
Independent scholarly review has not been performed.
title: One-erasure identifying codes of the dodecahedral graph: fifteen isolated optima with a Kneser intersection geometry
